overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Palladium K-1 Free ETF (UPAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in palladium commodities. The fund seeks 2x the daily performance of palladium prices through derivatives linked to palladium exposure. The strategy uses swaps and cash collateral rather than investing directly in physical palladium UPAL was launched on Apr 20, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
